title: Privacy Policy
details:
Privacy Policy

Personal Information


When you access our site, we may request certain personal information, such as your name, email, and phone number, to respond to your requests, share offers, or provide updates. We will not disclose, sell, share, or rent this information to third parties without your permission.


Payment Information


If you register for our services, we may collect payment details, such as credit card information, needed to process transactions. We use third-party services to process and verify payments, including the cardholder’s name, card number, expiration date, and billing address. This information will only be shared with third parties as necessary for processing payments.


Client Call Recording


To ensure quality and for monitoring purposes, RND Technosoft reserves the right to record both online and offline sessions between clients and our support team. We do not link session recordings with your personal information, maintaining your privacy and security.


Data Security


We take extensive measures to protect your privacy and data security. All sensitive information shared with us is protected through advanced encryption technologies, both online and offline, ensuring the highest levels of security.


Opt-Out Option


If you no longer wish to receive newsletters or promotional emails regarding our products or services, you can opt-out at any time.


Acceptance of Policy


By visiting our site or using our services, you agree to our Privacy Policy.


Policy Updates


RND Technosoft reserves the right to update, modify, or remove parts of this policy at any time. Continued use of our site or services signifies your acceptance of any changes.


Contact Us


For questions about our Privacy Policy, please reach out to us at hello@rndtechnosoft.com or call us directly at +91-7304945823.



This policy is designed to ensure that your personal information is handled with care and confidentiality at all times.

title: What Are Cookies
details:
Cookie Policy for RND Technosoft


This Cookie Policy explains how RND Technosoft uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. By continuing to use our website, you agree to our use of cookies as outlined below.


1. What Are Cookies?


Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They help us recognize your device, enhance your browsing experience, and improve our services by providing insights into how our site is used.


2. Types of Cookies We Use


Essential Cookies: These cookies are necessary for the basic functionality of our website, allowing you to navigate and use its features securely. Disabling these cookies may impact the website’s performance.

  

Performance and Analytics Cookies: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our site, providing information on page visits, traffic sources, and other analytical data. We use this data to improve our website and provide a better user experience.

  

Functionality Cookies: These cookies enable us to remember your preferences and settings, such as language preferences, to provide a personalized experience when you return to our site.


Advertising and Marketing Cookies: We may use cookies from third-party partners to deliver relevant advertisements and measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns. These cookies track your online activity to help us serve personalized ads based on your interests.


3. Third-Party Cookies


RND Technosoft may partner with third-party services, such as Google Analytics, to gather insights into site performance and user behavior. These third-party providers may use cookies on our behalf to analyze your interaction with our website. We do not control these cookies, and their usage is governed by the third-party's privacy policy.


4. Managing Cookies


You have the option to accept or decline cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can modify your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer. However, please note that disabling certain cookies may limit the functionality of our website and affect your user experience.


5. Updates to This Cookie Policy


RND Technosoft reserves the right to update or modify this Cookie Policy at any time. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we use cookies. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.


6. Contact Us


For questions or concerns about our Cookie Policy, please contact us at hello@rndtechnosoft.com or call +91-7304945823.




Note: By using our website, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy.
